2026-11-21.title: Saturday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time · The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
readings: The breath of life from God entered them
Blessed be the Lord, my Rock!
He is God not of the dead, but of the living
2026-11-21.alt: Memorial of the Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary. Some places use Zechariah 2:14–17 and Matthew 12:46–50 for the memorial.
2026-11-21.verse: Now he is God not of the dead, but of the living; for to him all of them are alive.
theo: The Sadducees, who denied the resurrection, try to make it look absurd with a story of seven brothers and one wife. Jesus answers on two levels. First, the risen life is not a copy of this one: “they cannot die anymore, because they are like angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.” Second, from the Torah the Sadducees accepted: God called himself the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob long after they had died. “He is God not of the dead, but of the living; for to him all of them are alive.”

In Revelation the two witnesses are killed, but after three and a half days “the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet”. Today's memorial of the Presentation of Mary, rooted in an ancient tradition (the Protoevangelium of James) and linked to the dedication of the church of St Mary in Jerusalem in 543, celebrates Mary's total belonging to God from her earliest years. She is the living temple, wholly given, whom the God of the living raised body and soul into glory.
outline: Ask: do you believe your loved ones who died are alive to God?
The patriarchs are alive to God.
Her presentation: a life wholly belonging to God.
“To him all of them are alive.”
live: Renew your baptismal consecration to God today, perhaps with a Marian prayer.
Pray for one departed person who is alive to God.
2026-11-21.prayer: God of the living, to you all are alive. As Mary gave herself wholly to you from her youth, let me belong to you completely, and raise me with all your saints on the last day. Amen.

quick: God is God of the living; to him all are alive.
The breath of God raises his faithful witnesses.
Mary belonged wholly to God from her earliest years.
2026-11-21.question: Do I belong wholly to God?

homily: Dear friends, the Sadducees, who denied the resurrection, try to make it look absurd with a story of seven brothers who each married the same woman. Whose wife will she be? Jesus answers that the risen life is not a copy of this one: those who rise cannot die any more, because they are like angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection (Luke 20:35–36).

Then he answers from the Torah they accepted: at the burning bush God called himself the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, long after they had died. He is God not of the dead but of the living, for to him all of them are alive (Luke 20:37–38).

In the first reading two witnesses are killed, and after three and a half days the breath of life from God enters them and they stand on their feet (Revelation 11:11). Death does not have the last word over God's witnesses.

Today we celebrate the Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary. An ancient tradition tells that Mary was offered to God in the Temple as a child. Her whole life was given to the God of the living. Let us give him our day, and pray the Angelus this week, joining Mary's yes. Amen.
kids: Children, today we remember little Mary being given to God. She said yes to God all her life. Say the Hail Mary today and give your day to God like her.

intro: To God all are alive; his breath raises his witnesses; Mary belonged wholly to him.

sub: God is still the God of the patriarchs.
q: He said further, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.

And the fact that the dead are raised Moses himself showed, in the story about the bush, where he speaks of the Lord as the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Now he is God not of the dead, but of the living; for to him all of them are alive.
points.apply: Pray for one departed person today.

sub: The risen life is new, not a copy.
q: Thus says the Lord GOD to these bones: I will cause breath to enter you, and you shall live.
Indeed they cannot die anymore, because they are like angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
points.apply: Thank God for the gift of eternal life.

sub: Hannah gave Samuel to the Lord.
Mary belonged wholly to God from her youth.
q: For this child I prayed; and the LORD has granted me the petition that I made to him. Therefore I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he lives, he is given to the LORD.
Then Mary said, “Here am I, the servant of the Lord; let it be with me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.
points.apply: Renew your consecration to God through Mary.

concl: We belong to the God of the living.
With Mary, let us give ourselves wholly to him.
2026-11-21.resolve: Pray the Angelus daily this week.
